variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.sub: The leader of {party}, {leader}, is the subject of a newly revealed scandal.
variants.body:
A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light. The revelation makes political trust an immediate subject of public attention. An assessment of {target} must distinguish that known fact from unreported details about the conduct involved, its cause or any proceedings that might follow.

The gazette confines its factual account to the revelation of the scandal. A political embarrassment and a finding under law are distinct matters. The public record is best served by keeping the distinction clear and by avoiding particulars which have not been supplied to this newspaper.

We consider {target} unfairly served by a rush to condemnation. A scandal's existence is not a complete account of responsibility, and a fair hearing remains worth defending even in unwelcome publicity. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.sub: A scandal about {leader}, leader of {party}, has become public.
variants.body:

variants.sub: A scandal concerning {leader}, the leader of {party}, has come to light.
variants.body:
